Add Stop: aim at the landing along the shaft. The first stop shows as 1st Stop (US) or First Stop (GB), not a floor.
Set First Stop: aim at the landing that should be the first stop. The car stays put.
Register Panel: OUTSIDE buttons only, at the stop the panel sits beside. The car does not have to be parked there. Never the inside panel.

SIDE LIFT
3D cabin that travels on X or Z. Smallest interior 1 wide by 2 high. Need at least two shaft walls. Deck: any block. Walls and ceiling: plates and/or hatches. The shaft roof is a half-cube lid over the whole horizontal run.
Doors at each stop. Cabin + landing doors on the same opening work as one set.
Locked outside doors call the car.
Cabin doors stay shut if there is no walkable landing outside (a drop or a wall).
Inside panel: two stops, press E to go to the next stop. More than two stops, hold E and pick a stop. A tap does nothing when there are more than two.
Players, vehicles, and loot in the cabin ride.

BOAT BRIDGE
Pad only. One garage or roll-up per dock. They stay put.
Pad at this stop: E opens that door. Pad elsewhere: E calls it, then the door opens on arrival.
Inside panel sits on the pad and rides. Do not register it. Two stops: press E to go to the next stop. More than two: hold E and pick a stop.
Do not build the pad out of Plate Double (pass-through). Use full cubes.

PLATES VS SHEETS
WALLS AND CEILING = PLATES or hatches (they ride). Deck = any block.
SHEETS, Plate Double, round ladders, and wall letters stay at the landing. Use sheets around button panels.

POWER
Wire any ONE registered outside panel on that side lift. Other shafts cannot power it.

STOP LETTER
Place a vanilla wall letter or number within 3 blocks of each outside door. It shows the stop the car is at, including while it is passing.
